Counsel for Opposite Party :- Arpit Singh,G.A.
Hon'ble Mrs. Manju Rani Chauhan,J.
1.

Heard Mr. Jai Raj, learned counsel for the applicants, Mr. Devi Dayal Tiwari, Advocate holding
brief of Mr. Arpit Singh, learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 as well as Mr. Amit Singh
Chauhan, learned counsel for the State and perused the material on record.

2.  This application u/s 482 has been filed by the applicants with the prayer to quash the impugned charge sheet dated 28.10.2022 along with Cognizance order dated 29.07.2024 and the entire proceeding of Criminal Case No.15292 of 2024 (State vs. Rishabh Ramani), arising out of Case Crime No.268 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station- Jagdishpura, District- Agra as well as stay the further proceeding of the aforesaid case,

sentences.text:
Earlier an Application U/S 482 No.33645 of 2024 (Rishabh Ramani And Another vs. State of U.P.
and Another) was filed before this Court wherein vide order dated 02.12.2024, the Court had directed the parties to appear before the court concerned for verification of the compromise.
In compliance of the aforesaid order, the statements of parties have been recorded wherein they have stated that they have entered into compromise and no dispute remains between them.

Accordingly,
the compromise has been verified by learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Ist, Agra vide order dated 17.12.2024.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Ist, Agra
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Certified copy of the aforesaid order dated 17.12.2024 has been annexed on page no.41 of this application.

4. Learned counsel for the applicants submits that since the compromise entered between the parties has been verified by the court below, the entire proceedings of the aforesaid criminal case may be quashed by this Court.

5. Learned A.G.A. for the State as well as learned counsel for opposite party no.2 also accept that the parties have entered into a compromise and the copy of the same has also been enclosed along with verification order, he has no objection, if the proceedings in the aforesaid case are quashed.
6.

This Court is not unmindful of the following judgements of the Apex Court:
(i). B.S. Joshi and others Vs. State of Haryana and Another; (2003)4 SCC 675,
(ii). Nikhil Merchant Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation; (2008) 9 SCC 677,
(iii). Manoj Sharma Vs. State and Others; (2008) 16 SCC 1,
(iv). Gian Singh Vs. State of Punjab; (2012); 10 SCC 303,
(v). Narindra Singh and others Vs. State of Punjab; ( 2014) 6 SCC 466,
7.

Reference may also be made to the decision given by this Court in Shaifullah and Others Vs. State of U.P. &
Another; 2013 (83) ACC 278 and Pramod & Another Vs. State of U.P. & Another (Application U/S 482 No.12174 of 2020, decided on 23rd February, 2021) and Daxaben Vs.
